item.description:
### Fixed - **Your phone can find your Mac again after the network hiccups.** If macOS's discovery service restarted — which it does on its own, and on some VPN and network changes — Perch stopped advertising itself on Wi-Fi and never started again. Nothing looked wrong: the Mac stayed connected over Tailscale and the menu bar was normal, but a phone on the same Wi-Fi searched forever. The longest this went unnoticed was eighteen hours. Perch now spots it and re-advertises on its own, which took under four seconds in testing.
### Changed - **Settings now tells you which network problem you have.** "Wi-Fi discovery dropped — re-advertising" means Perch lost its spot and is getting it back by itself, with nothing for you to do. The Local Network permission prompt now appears only when permission really is the problem — the one case where you do need to open System Settings.
